question: How can I add the Light, Dark and Auto dropdown to my Chulapa site? Does it work with the v2.1.0 gem and floating navigation?
expected: 2.2.0 only, not v2.1.0. Preserve existing chulapa-skin and add independent chulapa-skin-dark mapping with skin gitdev-dark and highlight github.dark. Works classic/fab/dual. Default Light, Auto tracks system; browser remembers choice when storage available; no JS uses Light. Shared vars need copying, custom CSS/widgets may need adjustment. Cite choose-skin guide. Omitted dark highlight inherits chulapa-skin.highlight, then default; other fields remain independent. Blank dark fields disable switching. Initial dark CSS failures restore Light; later failures retain current appearance and preserve the requested mode, including Auto. If security policy blocks inline scripts, ordinary light stylesheet links keep the page styled and the selector stays hidden.
